_comment: Editable durability ruleset for the no-AI fallback engine (DurabilityRuleClassifier), and the reference the Groq engine's prompt is grounded on. Decision order: (1) overrides -- exact phrases that force a full result; (2) tier keywords -- WEAKEST matched tier wins (order none < low < medium < high), so a mixed material (e.g. 'Solid Wood / Foam') resolves to its weakest component ('none'), matching the Groq engine's weakest-component rule and the conservative-bias principle; (3) a hollow-build keyword knocks the matched tier down one step; (4) brittleKeywords force brittle=true independent of tier; (5) deformableKeywords force deformable=true; (6) orientationKeywords set orientationLock (fixed beats partial on a tie); (7) no tier keyword matched -> defaultTier with confident=false, flagged for review. Matching is case-insensitive, whole-word, plural-aware -- same convention as fragility-rules.json.
